notes.title: Graphics update - game release date postponed.
notes.content: [h1]Good News [/h1][p]I’ve teamed up with [b]Marcin Mielczarek[/b] - who’s now reworking my helicopter – or better yet, totally redesigning it from scratch 😄 The new one’s gonna be sleek, futuristic, and just plain cool. Find out the sketches bellow. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462959/0a6ad98c32e20b8b667e7651356c2408333bec15.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Marcin has been in game-dev business for a long time, so definitely check out his portfolio at [url="https://www.mielczarekart.com"]https://www.mielczarekart.com[/url]. [/p][h1]Bad News - the release date[/h1][p]Due to major visual changes and new models being worked on, [b]the game’s release has been pushed to October 1st 2025[/b]. Yeah, yeah – I know, I just broke a few hearts out there 😅 But hey, good things are worth waiting an extra month or two, right?[/p][p]Hang in there, pilots – it's gonna be worth it![/p]

notes.title: Auto Switches Incoming!
notes.content: [p]Tired of [b]constantly hitting buttons[/b] to toggle lights or X-ray mode?[/p][p]Now you can turn on the [b]auto option[/b]![/p][p]Lights come on automatically when you're near obstacles, and X-ray activates when you're hidden from view (but heads up: it’s fully automatic, so it doesn’t care about battery life – you might run out fast!)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462959/0ef57c9750c859eaaa97459666af0c4453ae8e8c.jpg"][/img]Also new: a "flight assistant" for players who prefer a smooth and gentle flight – it helps you fly safer, though it won’t save you from everything 😉 You won’t go fast, true, but it’ll definitely be the safer way to fly! Work in progress..[/p][p]Exciting updates [b]coming soon![/b][/p]

notes.title: SPEEDRUN: Chase Your Shadow
notes.content: [p]A dedicated SPEEDRUN mode – this time with a [b]SHADOW visualization[/b]! This turns the game into a frantic [b]time attack[/b]. Every tenth of a second counts, and you’re racing against yourself and your friends. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462959/7c4a7b954d3e786a4ef774c58679635faf7dd40e.jpg"][/img]Watch out:[/p][list][*][p]The demo version has two dedicated racing levels: RESCUE 10 and RESCUE 2. [/p][/*][*][p]The full version will have more speedy maps![/p][/*][*][p]In the full version, it will be the global leaderboard![/p][/*][/list][p]Note: In speedrun mode, the rescue mission time is stopped, also no miners are counted in the main plot of the game. So feel free to play it - to [b]practice navigation[/b]! to use it for the [b]map discovery[/b]! And have fun![/p]
